links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-facing TKA responses (Coleman-Liau Index)
links.effect: Coleman-Liau Index was 12.3 ± 1.6 (Program 2), 12.8 ± 1.7 (Program 1), and 13.7 ± 2.5 (Program 3), all well above typical patient reading levels; differences significant (P < 0.0001).
links.quote: Readability differed significantly (P < 0.0001): Program 2 was most accessible (CLI 12.3 ± 1.6), Program 1 intermediate (12.8 ± 1.7), and Program 3 least readable (13.7 ± 2.5).

links.outcome: Readability of LLM patient-facing TKA responses (Coleman-Liau Index)
links.effect: CLI grade levels of 12.3 to 13.7 across three LLMs, above plain-language levels; Program 3 least readable (P < 0.0001).
links.quote: Readability differed significantly (P < 0.0001): Program 2 was most accessible (CLI 12.3 ± 1.6), Program 1 intermediate (12.8 ± 1.7), and Program 3 least readable (13.7 ± 2.5).

links.outcome: Evidence citation validity index (ECVI) of LLM responses
links.effect: ECVI was 7.7 ± 1.5 for Program 3, 7.1 ± 0.8 for Program 2, and 5.6 ± 0.6 for Program 1, so citation validity varied across models.
links.quote: Program 3 showed stronger ECVI (7.7 ± 1.5) than Program 2 (7.1 ± 0.8) and Program 1 (5.6 ± 0.6).

links.outcome: Composite clinical reliability (accuracy, safety, hallucination) of LLM TKA answers vs surgeon ratings
links.effect: Median CCRS was 84.0 (Program 2), 76.5 (Program 3), and 73.0 (Program 1) (P < 0.0001); inter-rater ICC 0.87.
links.quote: Program 2 achieved the highest CCRS (median 84.0, interquartile range [IQR] 82.0 to 85.0), outperforming Program 3 (76.5, 65.0 to 83.8) and Program 1 (73.0, 69.0 to 79.0) (P < 0.0001), with superior accuracy, guideline adherence, hallucination control, and safety framing.

unlisted_practices: Composite Clinical Reliability Score as a multi-domain framework for evaluating patient-facing LLM output

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the clinical reliability, safety, hallucination rate, and readability of three LLMs answering patient questions about total knee arthroplasty, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
